parsed.explanation: A minimal transversal of a family of finite sets need not itself be finite. Thus π(T) is not defined for the Zorn-minimal transversal T unless finiteness is proved. Step 4 applies self-duality precisely to such a T inside I∪Z_ω, while no finite I∪Z_s is a transversal. The write-up supplies neither a proof that this T is finite nor a separate all-terms large-prime-erasure/finiteness argument. Repair therefore requires a substantive lemma, not a local wording change.
